correctness.rationale: For n>=3, the exact C_n square K_2 graph distance is cyclic rung distance plus layer mismatch. A two-packing corresponds to a 0/A/B cyclic word with no adjacent occupied rungs and opposite letters at distance two. Five two-letter states give the claimed determinant (1+ux^2)(1-x-ux^2-ux^3), hence rational generating function. Direct cyclic gap decomposition with excess t=n-2k produces n/k sum_r 2^r binom(k,r)binom(t-1,r-1); all gap2 case alternates iff k even giving 4. Extremal residues n odd/0mod4/2mod4 give exact counts 2n/4/n(n-2); known URRDF-twopacking bijection on cubic ladder translates weight 2n-2k. Independently enumerated distance-two packings on actual graph through n=10 (including C3,C4 boundaries) and matched coefficients; full n result is from cyclic transfer and gap proof.
